components.name: Event Panel
components.description: Trigger fields as rows of name and value.
components.css: .ds-event{margin:0;padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0);border-radius:14px;background:oklch(1 0 0);box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0 0 / 0.05),0 12px 32px -12px oklch(0.2 0 0 / 0.12)}.ds-event div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed oklch(0.9 0 0)}.ds-event div:first-child{border-top:0}.ds-event dt{font:13px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;color:oklch(0.46 0 0)}.ds-event dd{margin:0;font:500 14px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Battle Board
components.description: An example score that fills with reading progress.
components.css: .ds-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;font:600 15px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace}.ds-board b{color:oklch(0.56 0.21 358)}.ds-board em{font-style:normal;color:oklch(0.46 0 0)}.ds-bar{display:flex;height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}.ds-bar i{background:oklch(0.56 0.21 358)}.ds-bar s{background:oklch(0.6 0 0);opacity:.55}

narrative.overview: Plugin pages look like they came out of OSC Flow Studio: neutral greys, Inter, and one accent per plugin, the same accent the catalog gives it. Data is shown as data, in a monospace face with tabular numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ground, one plugin accent, light and dark from the system.
Field names and numbers in JetBrains Mono.
Hairline dividers instead of card grids.
No third-party logos or brand colours.

rules.name: The Host Rule
rules.body: Pink marks the streamer's side or the one action that matters; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Anything a flow reads is set in the data face, exactly as the flow spells it.

dos: Do show real field names and label example values as examples.
Do credit third-party software with links.
Do keep every page complete with motion off and in both colour schemes.
donts: Don't use TikTok's logo, stylised name or brand colours.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading, or number sections.
Don't use em or en dashes in page copy.
Don't build fake product UI from divs.
